name: @dongasai/dsh-setting-pro
description: Resize the DSH Web settings dialog (default 800x800), group its controls on a dedicated Settings -> Advanced page, and add Host controls: restart / restart-when-idle, last start time, a dsh version / update check, a machine name that takes over the sidebar brand area (falling back to a line under the logo), an always-visible status chip next to the logo (running sessions with workspace and title details on hover, idle when nothing runs), and a read-only provider / model / thinking-level cell added beside the official composer performance-and-usage pills, plus a Host-side toggle for whether the three restart tools are exposed to agents (register/unregister at runtime, no restart needed).

meta.title: 设置弹窗尺寸与 Host 运维
meta.description: 把设置面板从默认 800×800 放大、控制项收在「设置 → 高级设置」页里；同一页提供重启 dsh / 空闲后重启、最后启动时间，以及 dsh 版本与更新提示、机器名字（直接顶替左上角品牌区，失败才退回 logo 下一行）、logo 后面常驻的状态指示（忙时「运行中 ×N」悬停看 工作区·会话，空闲时「空闲」），以及在输入框下方「性能与用量」那一行旁边并列加一格只读的「供应商 · 模型 · 思考档位」；另有一个「开放给 agent」开关，即时注册/注销那三个重启工具（不用重启 dsh）。
